title: ESPD Section
description: A top-level section within an ESPD part (criterion, procedure info, operator info, or concluding statement)

tag.description: Section tag identifier (e.g. C01, PI01, EO01, CS01, OT65)

name.description: Full name combining tag and code (e.g. PI01_proc-publication-info)

part.description: Which ESPD part this section belongs to

sectionTitle.description: Sub-section heading (e.g. A: Grounds relating to criminal convictions)

components.description: Child components (question groups, subcriteria, legislation, etc.)

requestpath.description: Root request path for this section

responsepath.description: Root response path for this section

mandatoryInRequest.description: Indicates whether the criterion must always be included in an ESPD Request and cannot be deselected by the Contracting Authority.
